planning.title: Plan this week's training
planning.explanation: Choose trainees, check recorded minutes and divide the remaining time between the league and a friendly.
planning.selectTrainees: Choose trainees from the whole squad
planning.rosterLoading: Waiting for the squad. If loading failed, retry synchronization.
planning.selectHint: Select the players whose development you want to plan.
planning.coverageTitle: How much training will your trainees receive?
planning.coverageReady: The plan covers 90 effective minutes for every selected trainee.
planning.coveragePending: Some minutes or data still need attention.
planning.unknownEffectHint: Small and very small effects are excluded because the manual does not specify their numerical fractions.
planning.coverageHint: The best 90 minutes count: full effect takes priority over half effect. This is basic training coverage, without special set-piece bonuses, a skill-up forecast or a guarantee the match will go to plan. Missing data is not zero training.
planning.datesHint: Enter future matches before the next training update. Finished matches are already in the report; do not add them again. Times are local.
planning.fixturesError: Fixtures are unavailable. You can enter dates manually; the plan remains a draft until a fixture is confirmed.
planning.prepareLineup: Complete the lineup in the optimizer
planning.suggestHint: Set match dates first. The suggestion fills free full-training slots and preserves manual entries.
planning.unassigned: Full training could not be allocated — check dates, availability and slots:
planning.skippedUnknown: Skipped players without confirmed minutes in the report:
planning.suggested: The selected trainees' minutes are allocated. Review the plan, then complete each lineup in the optimizer.
planning.handoffHint: Required starting players and their positions are passed to the optimizer. Planned minutes and substitutions are not match orders; include them when setting substitutions in Hattrick.
planning.saveError: The browser could not save this plan. Your changes remain on this screen only.
planning.saved: Saved in this browser for this team and week:
planning.details: Show the detailed report and calculation method

issues.unknownType: Numerical coverage is unavailable for this training type.
issues.unknownWeek: The team or training week could not be confirmed. Refresh the report.
issues.unknownDate: Enter a match date to include the planned minutes in this week.
issues.pastMatch: This date is earlier than the report cutoff. A finished match cannot be counted again.
issues.outsideWeek: The match is outside this training week.
issues.missingPlayer: The player is not in the current squad.
issues.invalidMinutes: Choose a position and whole minutes within 0–90; playing time must be positive.
issues.injured: The player is injured. Planned minutes are excluded.
issues.suspended: The optimizer currently excludes suspended players from friendly lineups as well. This assignment is excluded from coverage and cannot be passed to optimization.
issues.optimizerUnavailable: The player cannot be selected by the optimizer with the current data. This assignment is excluded; check availability and skill completeness.
issues.unknownAvailability: Availability is unconfirmed. Check injuries and suspensions.
issues.unknownEffect: This position has an unquantified effect and does not count as full or half training.
issues.playerOverlap: The player has overlapping playing intervals.
issues.slotOverlap: Two players occupy the same position at the same time.
issues.illegalFormation: These simultaneous positions cannot be completed into a legal formation supported by the optimizer.
